items.title: No10 insists UK military base RAF Fairford is safe after US withdraws bombers
items.description: US media reported a new threat led to the bombers being removed on Sunday, following an incident near the base last week.

items.title: Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests
items.description: Sánchez says Spain will head to the polls on 29 November after recent defeats on measures aimed at addressing the country's housing crisis.

items.title: Flydubai co-pilot planned to crash plane into Tel Aviv airport or building, reports say
items.description: The Omani national was a "lone wolf" extremist, according to the reports.

items.title: Teenager's hand blown off during confrontation between France school protesters and police
items.description: The prefect of Pas-de-Calais says the 15-year-old's life is "not in danger" after the "very serious" incident.

items.title: Nobel Prize awarded for revealing inner workings of the brain
items.description: US psychiatrist and neurologist Karl Deisseroth and his German colleagues Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have been awarded for their work.

items.title: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
items.description: The vessel's captain was killed and 11 crew members were rescued after the attack on the Turkish-owned ship, Ukraine's leader says.

items.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
items.description: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.

items.title: Right-wing Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round of Brazil election
items.description: With neither candidate getting more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

items.title: Georgia officials hunt for suspect in shooting that killed two and injured 35
items.description: A homecoming celebration turned into a scene of deadly violence, as dozens of shots were fired into a crowd.

items.title: Bombs preventing rescue of kidnapped youths, Nigerian police say
items.description: The father of one of the 19 young abductees tells the BBC he hasn't eaten in three days out of worry.

items.title: Yemeni government forces say they have 'secured' Bab al-Mandab Strait
items.description: Houthi-run media deny the government has made advances in the Dhubab area, which overlooks the strategic Red Sea waterway.

items.title: All six passengers presumed dead after plane went missing off US coast
items.description: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.
